productivebeesgenesis.configuration.bree: Acquire Myriad Creations bee through breeding
productivebeesgenesis.configuration.pare: First parent bee type (registry name, e.g. productivebees:myriadcreations)
productivebeesgenesis.configuration.spaw: Acquire Myriad Creations bee through nest spawning
productivebeesgenesis.configuration.nest: Nest block for bee spawning (e.g. productivebees:stone_nest)

productivebeesgenesis.configuration.resu: Result bee type (registry name, e.g. productivebees:myriadcreations)
productivebeesgenesis.configuration.item: Item ID required for conversion (e.g. minecraft:stick)
productivebeesgenesis.configuration.myri: Max produce events per game tick per Myriad bee (0=unlimited). Reduces CPU load in heavily accelerated setups.
productivebeesgenesis.configuration.save: Advanced beehive NBT save interval (ticks). Reduces CompoundTag serialization overhead under high acceleration. Default 20 (1s), range 1-200. Higher values improve performance but risk data loss on crash.
productivebeesgenesis.configuration.simu: Cooldown between farmer/hoarder/collector queries in simulateBee(). 0 = no limit (vanilla behavior). Recommended 1-5 under high load.
productivebeesgenesis.configuration.ener: Energy consumption per tick per process (FE)
productivebeesgenesis.configuration.proc: Base processing time in ticks per operation
productivebeesgenesis.configuration.ejec: Output slot auto-eject delay. Vanilla Mekanism=10 (0.5s). Lower=faster ejection, higher server load. Recommended: 2 (0.1s)
Eject delay when output slots still contain items (active state). Default 1 (0.05s) for high-throughput scenarios. Lower=faster ejection, higher server load.
productivebeesgenesis.configuration.flui: Base fluid output tank capacity (mB), factory version multiplies by process count. Default: 256000 (256 buckets).
productivebeesgenesis.configuration.mekC: Rate at which fluid is auto-ejected from MEK centrifuges. Default 16384 mB/tick, overrides Mekanism default 1024.
productivebeesgenesis.configuration.comb: Multiplier for item and fluid output when centrifuging comb blocks (comb block = N combs)
productivebeesgenesis.configuration.mekC: Max items extractable per game tick via pipes/AE2 (0=unlimited). Prevents ME interface overload.
Consecutive failed outputItems attempts before entering cooldown. Default 3.
Ticks to skip outputItems when output is blocked. Default 15 (0.75s). 0 disables cooldown.
productivebeesgenesis.configuration.ejec: Skip ejector output attempts when output slots have not changed, reducing CPU cost under high acceleration.
Consecutive ticks to skip ejector output attempts when output slots are unchanged. 0 = never skip. Default 1.
Disables Ejector throttling (skip/interval/busy cooldown) while keeping blocked cooldown, maximizing item ejection speed. Use only when the target container has ample space and server headroom.
Minimum tick interval between outputItems calls when output slots keep changing. Default 0 (disabled).
Consecutive outputItems calls that did not reduce total output count before entering long cooldown. Default 5.
Ticks to skip outputItems when output ejection is busy but not fully blocked. Default 40 (2s). 0 disables.
Max outputItems calls per tick (0=unlimited). Limits repeated outputItems calls under 256x acceleration. Default 64; skipped in max speed mode.
productivebeesgenesis.configuration.aeOu: When AE2 is installed, centrifuge acts as a grid node and actively pushes outputs to the AE2 network, bypassing SFM and reducing high-frequency AEItemKey creation. No effect without AE2. Default off.
